name: data-analysis-implementation
description: Data Analysis & Implementation — a bilingual, offline-first course site. The site itself has no dependencies and no build step for the browser; this file exists for the end-to-end suite and the diagram renderer.

scripts.build: python tools/trace_gen.py && node tools/render_diagrams.mjs && python build.py && python scripts/build-sw.py
scripts.check: python build.py --check --strict && python scripts/build-sw.py --check && python tools/verify_chapter.py
